read_only_inspection.exploration: controlBefore and targetBefore precede governed write; successful write precedes sleep/target query; separate exploration summary inserted afterwards.
read_only_inspection.node_journal: post-write hook deduplicates anchors, skips unchanged values, creates node journal for agent/rollback source.
read_only_inspection.recipe: batch run created before sequential write/verify; graded results saved to run. Recipe update is separate from trial/apply.
read_only_inspection.profile: dispatch rejects direct node/recipe writes for observation/training/optimization profiles with profile-specific tool restrictions.
